CustomField.label: Advisory Only
CustomField.description: TRUE when the routing answer named a source/target pair the accelerator cannot process. The readiness tier is suppressed entirely (Assessment_Tier__c is left null) rather than shown with a caveat: banding a migration-feasibility instrument for a pair the tool cannot handle is a promise the offering cannot keep. The raw score and section breakdown are still stored, because they are still useful qualitative input for a manual conversation. Set by GtmAssessmentScoring; see Advisory_Reason__c for which half of the pair was the problem.
